training_annotations: canonical-expanded:196 complete reviewed frames,1434 player/goalie boxes; assistant-reviewed, not independent human ground truth
frozen: Vision/text backbones, transformer encoder, geometry encoder, segmentation head, and temporal tracker. This is box-supervised detector adaptation, not mask or temporal-tracker training.
augmentation: Each training frame and its horizontal flip, with exactly mirrored boxes. No validation augmentation. Frozen backbone outputs cached at float32/bfloat16 original precision.
optimizer: AdamW, weight_decay0.0001, gradient_clip1.0, batch1, seed17,20epochs, cosine LR decay to10%. No early test feedback.
loss: Final one-to-one decoder outputs only, model eval mode with gradients enabled. Hungarian matching on5*L1+2*negativeGIoU-probability; training loss5*L1+2*(1-GIoU)+sigmoid focal(alpha0.25,gamma2), normalized by ground-truth boxes. Presence multiplication follows official inference scoring. No mask loss or guessed rectangle masks.
selection: Validate after each epoch. Max validation F1 over thresholds0.1..0.9, then precision, then higher threshold; select best checkpoint across variants before regression. Original checkpoint is a candidate. Never choose using regression results.
smoke: Check finite nonzero gradients, changed trainable parameters, unchanged excluded parameter groups and falling loss on four training frames before full runs.
video_transfer: Load only selected detector parameter delta into native SAM3 detector after strict key/shape validation. Evaluate tracking separately; detection gains need not improve identities.
